$schema_note: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Work IQ Teams corpus for the Capital Markets Client Intelligence Agent. The Bank Capital Markets is a branding label only. Gibson Energy Inc. is a real public company, used only so the Web IQ layer's live grounding returns genuine public news - every internal figure, colleague, exposure, limit, covenant, approval and policy referenced here is invented for a demo.
scenario: The Bank Capital Markets - preparation for the 8 October 2026 Gibson Energy (TSX:GEI) CFO/Treasurer coverage meeting

team.description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Coverage team workspace for the Gibson Energy Inc. (TSX:GEI) relationship. Every figure, message, policy and decision in this team was generated for a demonstration.

channels.description: Team-wide announcements and the FY26 account plan.

conversations.subject: FY26 account plan signed

replies.message: Read. The gap that jumps out is ECM - zero revenue against an estimated CAD 2.8m of street wallet. We have never been on an equity mandate for this name.
And we are number one in commodity derivatives. That is the position I want protected before we go chasing the ones we have never had.
Noting for the record that the plan lists a target hold of CAD 210m on the revolver. That number has not been to Credit Committee. It is an ambition in a planning document, not an approval.
Correct and the plan says so. Nobody puts that number in front of a client.

conversations.message: Account plan for Gibson Energy is signed and filed under Client Files. Headline: FY26 YTD revenue CAD 8.42m vs CAD 7.14m same period FY25, up 17.9 per cent. Wallet share 21.4 per cent, up from 18.9, now ranked second. Three H2 objectives - revolver upsize, hedging overlay, position for the 2027 maturity. Read it before the 8 October meeting.

conversations.subject: Q2 results

replies.message: Understood. I will read the release and nothing in this channel.
Leverage went 3.94x to 4.18x on a full quarter of acquisition debt service. Against a 4.50x covenant that is 0.32 turns. I will come back with the pro-forma.

conversations.message: Q2 is still Gibson's latest quarterly release on the public record. Everything in the release is public and usable. Nothing any of us says in this team about our own credit view, our limits or our rating is. Robin stays public side.

conversations.subject: Thursday is items 1, 2 and 5

replies.message: Fine by me. I would rather not present a structure I could not evidence anyway - I still do not have the contracted volume split.
Pack reissued in Client Files, version 3. Agenda items 3 and 4 removed rather than reworded.

conversations.message: Control Room has cleared the agenda in part under CR-2026-0184. We run items 1, 2 and 5. Item 3 is not cleared for solicitation. Item 4 we do not raise. Sasha reissuing the pack, Vance's credit block stands. Nobody freelances in the room.

channels.description: Day-to-day coverage, client interactions, call reports and meeting preparation.

conversations.subject: Treasurer call - three takeaways

replies.message: Good discipline on the qualification. Make sure it is in the call report in those words - CP-014 wants the indication and the qualification recorded, not just the indication.
The differential comment is the most valuable thing in this call. That is a client telling us the problem. I will come back with a shape.
Before anyone comes back with anything - do not indicate a hold. Sector is amber and the leverage covenant is at 0.32 turns. Pro-forma required before pitch under CP-005, not before mandate.
Understood. Nothing goes to them before your pro-forma.

conversations.message: Call report filed. Three things: (1) they want the revolver upsized from CAD 1.10bn to around CAD 1.35bn with a one-year extension and asked what our appetite is at a bigger hold; (2) they are unhappy with post-Chauvin differential exposure - 'we got the volume, we did not get the hedge'; (3) they asked unprompted about sustainability-linked structures. I gave no numbers and said anything I indicate is subject to internal approval.

conversations.subject: Open commitment from 16 July is still open

replies.message: Close it before Thursday. Repeatedly carrying an unclosed commitment forward is a relationship failure and it gets reported in the quarterly conduct review. I would rather it was closed badly than open.

Closed. Sent this afternoon. We will not win on price - the incumbent owns the operating accounts. Our argument is the asymmetry: CAD 0.315m of cash management revenue, about 22 per cent share, ranked third, against a CAD 465m committed lending position.

conversations.message: We owed them a cash management comparison from the 16 July meeting. It is nine weeks old. It is a mandatory field in the pre-meeting brief as an open commitment from the previous meeting. I do not want to carry it into a second brief.

conversations.subject: Draft agenda sent to Control Room unchanged

replies.message: That is the right call. CP-008 says clearance is sought on the agenda as it stands, not on a narrowed description of it. If they cut something, we take the cut.
Add the two housekeeping items to the brief as well - the outstanding KYC documents and the cash management comparison. Both are CP-014 fields.

conversations.message: Five items: relationship review; revolver upsize to CAD 1.35bn plus one-year extension; hedging overlay; 2027 refinancing; sustainability-linked options. Sent to Control Room in exactly this form per Sydney - I did not soften item 3 or drop item 4 to make clearance easier.

conversations.subject: I am out of the meeting

replies.message: Noted and respected. Nobody will ask.

conversations.message: For the record - since the name went restricted I have not published, not changed the rating or target price, and have declined two client calls on GEI. I am not attending 8 October and I have asked not to be copied. The published FY26 H2 midstream sector memo is public and can be used as it stands; please do not ask me to write something new for a client meeting while the restriction is live, because that is participation in marketing.

channels.description: Exposure, limits, covenants, pro-forma tests and credit approvals.

conversations.subject: Where the limits actually sit

replies.message: So on the single name we have room for the upsize.

On the single name, yes. That is not the binding constraint. Energy sector is CAD 2,744m of CAD 3,200m - 85.8 per cent, amber. Midstream sub-ceiling CAD 1,600m and sub-ceilings are hard. An incremental CAD 45m of hold is a rounding error to them and is not a rounding error to us.
Then we structure it as arrangement above final hold with a documented sell-down, which is what CP-002 says the default should be when a sector is amber.

conversations.message: Posting the numbers so nobody has to guess. Committed CAD 465m across five facilities, drawn CAD 288.4m, measured exposure CAD 341.7m against a CAD 500m single-name limit - 68.3 per cent, green. Derivative pre-settlement line CAD 90m, utilised CAD 69.2m - 76.9 per cent, amber. Underwriting commitment limit CAD 250m, unutilised. Headroom is not authority.

conversations.subject: Pro-forma complete

replies.message: So the answer is not no. The answer is yes with a covenant conversation attached.
That is my position. Negotiate relief or a step-down at the same time, not as a follow-on request in six months when the headroom has gone.
Which is a much better conversation to have while we are second in wallet and rising than after a bad print.

Also flagging the add-back point. Their calculation includes run-rate acquisition synergies. I track the unadjusted ratio in parallel. They do not straddle a band this quarter. They will if realised synergies lag.

conversations.message: Pro-forma on the upsize to CAD 1.35bn with our hold at CAD 210m, fully drawn assumption at the next two test dates per CP-005. Fully drawn at CAD 1.35bn it is 4.59x against the 4.50x maximum - a breach on the base case. Largest increase that clears is CAD 195.8m, at zero headroom. Current 4.18x of 4.50x, 0.32 turns, Tight band. Prior quarter 3.94x.

conversations.subject: KYC clock - 51 days

replies.message: That is the real deadline on this transaction, not the Credit Committee calendar.
Raise the outstanding documents on Thursday as housekeeping. Not as a condition. It must not read as leverage.

Agreed. Also flagging sanctions - screen clean 27 September on the obligor and beneficial owners, but the terminal and marine counterparties on the Chauvin volumes were not in that run. A clean screen on the obligor is not a clean screen on the flow.

conversations.message: Periodic KYC refresh due 25 November 2026, two documents outstanding. From the due date, no grace period: no new products, no increase to any committed facility completed, no new derivative documentation executed. Credit Committee is five business days once convened. If approval lands late November and the refresh has not completed we get an approval we cannot execute.

conversations.subject: Credit block final

replies.message: In the brief, not attached to it. The covenant line goes in even though it is uncomfortable.

conversations.message: Final for the brief. Internal IG-6, trend improving, not watchlisted, held at IG-6 at the 31 July review. Two quarters ago IG-7. Public S&P BBB- stable / DBRS BBB (low) stable. Tightest covenant Total Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDA at 4.18x of 4.50x, 0.32 turns, Tight. Senior secured 2.61x of 3.50x comfortable. Interest coverage 4.12x of 2.50x minimum comfortable. Tangible net worth CAD 1,486m of CAD 1,150m minimum comfortable. Next test 30 September. Last full credit review 18 March 2026, next due 31 March 2027 - current, so the limit is not frozen.

channels.description: Commodity and FX structures, pre-settlement lines, execution readiness.

conversations.subject: Shape of the Chauvin overlay

replies.message: It does not fit. A 24-month differential at CAD 240m does not sit inside CAD 20.8m of remaining PSE headroom on a differential add-on. Differential add-ons are higher than outright at the same notional - fatter-tailed spread distribution.
Then it comes down or it changes shape. I am not quoting a differential on an outright add-on.

And note the PSE line is a sub-limit of the CAD 500m single-name limit and consumes it. A bigger derivative position and a bigger loan hold are competing for the same limit. If the revolver goes to CAD 210m the arithmetic tightens for both of you.
That is worth Sydney hearing before Thursday. We are not choosing between two products, we are choosing how to spend one limit.

conversations.message: Roughly CAD 240m notional over 24 months - a WTI-WCS differential piece on the incremental barrels and a CAD/USD forward strip against USD revenue. Indicative revenue about CAD 0.94m over the life. Three things needed first: documented underlying exposure per CP-010, credit pre-clearance on the pre-settlement line per CP-004, and Tier 2 scenario illustration including the adverse case.

conversations.subject: Three options after resizing

replies.message: A is the one I can support today without a limit change. C I would not run alongside the revolver - two limit asks in the same committee cycle is how you get neither.
A. It does more of what the client actually asked for and it survives a bad month.

A is built and priced with the three-scenario illustration drafted. What I still do not have is the contracted volume split, so without it what I present is a framework and questions, not a structure. And I have no Control Room clearance.

conversations.message: Option A: keep CAD 240m total, split it - smaller differential, larger CAD/USD strip. FX carries a lower add-on so it fits, revenue drops. Option B: keep the differential weighting, cut notional to fit. Better revenue per unit of limit, covers less of their actual exposure. Option C: increase the PSE line - a limit change, same Credit Committee as the revolver, competing for the same single-name limit. My view is A.

conversations.subject: Item 3 not cleared - standing down

replies.message: You called this on Sunday and you did not solicit while it was unclear. That is exactly what should have happened.
Silver lining - the PSE headroom stays where it is, which makes the revolver conversation cleaner.

conversations.message: Control Room has determined a structure sized to the acquired volumes touches the restricted subject matter closely enough that solicitation is not permitted while CR-2026-0184 is live. I can discuss general differential market conditions. I cannot present a sized structure and cannot solicit. Standing down on item 3.
